Sarah defeats the half-god opponent. She selects the legendary Sea Abyss Scale Armor; the system completes S-rank task 'Lucky God's Favor' stage one and grants the Lucky Altar Construction Blueprint.
The party begins travel toward the second task coordinates; no explicit item receipt recorded.
Sea Abyss Scale Armor is assigned to Malenina and restores 10% divine awakening to her set; no additional item receipt.
